items.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued October 7 at 7:59PM EDT until October 8 at 10:00AM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Isolated minor coastal flooding.

* WHERE...Coastal Palm Beach County, Coastal Broward County,
Coastal Miami Dade County and Far South Miami-Dade County.

* WHEN...Through Thursday morning.

* IMPACTS...Some water on low lying roads and property.
items.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.
